etims_items_scope_branch_chk.name: etims_items_scope_branch_chk
etims_items_scope_branch_chk.value: ("etims_items"."config_source" = 'company' and "etims_items"."branch_id" is null) or ("etims_items"."config_source" = 'branch' and "etims_items"."branch_id" is not null)

media_assets_location_chk.name: media_assets_location_chk
media_assets_location_chk.value: ("media_assets"."provider" = 'external' and "media_assets"."source_url" is not null) or ("media_assets"."provider" <> 'external' and "media_assets"."storage_key" is not null)

number_series_alloc_document_uidx.name: number_series_alloc_document_uidx
number_series_alloc_document_uidx.where: "number_series_allocations"."document_kind" is not null and "number_series_allocations"."document_id" is not null

petty_cash_replenishments_approver_chk.name: petty_cash_replenishments_approver_chk
petty_cash_replenishments_approver_chk.value: "petty_cash_replenishments"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "petty_cash_replenishments"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "petty_cash_replenishments"."created_by"

petty_cash_replenishments_paid_chk.name: petty_cash_replenishments_paid_chk
petty_cash_replenishments_paid_chk.value: "petty_cash_replenishments"."status" <> 'paid' OR ("petty_cash_replenishments"."register_id" IS NOT NULL AND "petty_cash_replenishments"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL AND "petty_cash_replenishments"."reference" IS NOT NULL)

petty_cash_vouchers_kind_chk.name: petty_cash_vouchers_kind_chk
petty_cash_vouchers_kind_chk.value: ("petty_cash_vouchers"."kind" = 'vendor_invoice') = ("petty_cash_vouchers"."purchase_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("petty_cash_vouchers"."kind" = 'vendor_invoice' OR "petty_cash_vouchers"."expense_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

petty_cash_vouchers_approver_chk.name: petty_cash_vouchers_approver_chk
petty_cash_vouchers_approver_chk.value: "petty_cash_vouchers"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "petty_cash_vouchers"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "petty_cash_vouchers"."created_by"

petty_cash_vouchers_paid_chk.name: petty_cash_vouchers_paid_chk
petty_cash_vouchers_paid_chk.value: "petty_cash_vouchers"."status" NOT IN ('paid','reversed') OR ("petty_cash_vouchers"."register_id" IS NOT NULL AND "petty_cash_vouchers"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL AND "petty_cash_vouchers"."paid_on" IS NOT NULL)

projects_dates_chk.name: projects_dates_chk
projects_dates_chk.value: "projects"."end_on" IS NULL OR "projects"."start_on" IS NULL OR "projects"."end_on" >= "projects"."start_on"

purchase_order_amendments_approver_chk.name: purchase_order_amendments_approver_chk
purchase_order_amendments_approver_chk.value: "purchase_order_amendments"."decided_by" IS NULL OR "purchase_order_amendments"."status" <> 'applied' OR NOT "purchase_order_amendments"."needs_approval" OR "purchase_order_amendments"."decided_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "purchase_order_amendments"."proposed_by"

purchase_orders_approver_chk.name: purchase_orders_approver_chk
purchase_orders_approver_chk.value: "purchase_orders"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "purchase_orders"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "purchase_orders"."created_by"

rfq_quote_lines_bid_chk.name: rfq_quote_lines_bid_chk
rfq_quote_lines_bid_chk.value: "rfq_quote_lines"."no_bid" OR ("rfq_quote_lines"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL AND "rfq_quote_lines"."quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "rfq_quote_lines"."quantity" > 0)

supplier_invoices_four_eyes_chk.name: supplier_invoices_four_eyes_chk
supplier_invoices_four_eyes_chk.value: "supplier_invoices"."approved_by" IS NULL OR ("supplier_invoices"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "supplier_invoices"."linked_by" AND "supplier_invoices"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "supplier_invoices"."matched_by")

units_of_measure_base_chk.name: units_of_measure_base_chk
units_of_measure_base_chk.value: ("units_of_measure"."base_unit_id" IS NULL AND "units_of_measure"."factor_to_base" = 1) OR ("units_of_measure"."base_unit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "units_of_measure"."base_unit_id" <> "units_of_measure"."id" AND "units_of_measure"."kind" <> 'packaging')

vendor_advance_payments_approver_chk.name: vendor_advance_payments_approver_chk
vendor_advance_payments_approver_chk.value: "vendor_advance_payments"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "vendor_advance_payments"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_advance_payments"."created_by"

vendor_bank_four_eyes_chk.name: vendor_bank_four_eyes_chk
vendor_bank_four_eyes_chk.value: ("vendor_bank_accounts"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "vendor_bank_accounts"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_bank_accounts"."proposed_by") AND ("vendor_bank_accounts"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "vendor_bank_accounts"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_bank_accounts"."callback_by")

vendor_credit_memos_posted_chk.name: vendor_credit_memos_posted_chk
vendor_credit_memos_posted_chk.value: "vendor_credit_memos"."state" <> 'posted' OR ("vendor_credit_memos"."register_id" IS NOT NULL AND "vendor_credit_memos"."ledger_entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

vendor_credit_memos_four_eyes_chk.name: vendor_credit_memos_four_eyes_chk
vendor_credit_memos_four_eyes_chk.value: "vendor_credit_memos"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "vendor_credit_memos"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_credit_memos"."assigned_to"

vendor_payment_batches_confirmer_chk.name: vendor_payment_batches_confirmer_chk
vendor_payment_batches_confirmer_chk.value: "vendor_payment_batches"."confirmed_by" IS NULL OR "vendor_payment_batches"."confirmed_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_payment_batches"."released_by"

vendor_payment_vouchers_approver_chk.name: vendor_payment_vouchers_approver_chk
vendor_payment_vouchers_approver_chk.value: "vendor_payment_vouchers"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "vendor_payment_vouchers"."approved_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_payment_vouchers"."created_by"

vendor_payment_vouchers_payer_chk.name: vendor_payment_vouchers_payer_chk
vendor_payment_vouchers_payer_chk.value: NOT "vendor_payment_vouchers"."needs_three" OR "vendor_payment_vouchers"."paid_by" IS NULL OR ("vendor_payment_vouchers"."paid_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_payment_vouchers"."created_by" AND "vendor_payment_vouchers"."paid_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "vendor_payment_vouchers"."approved_by")

vendor_payment_vouchers_paid_chk.name: vendor_payment_vouchers_paid_chk
vendor_payment_vouchers_paid_chk.value: "vendor_payment_vouchers"."status" NOT IN ('paid','reversed') OR ("vendor_payment_vouchers"."register_id" IS NOT NULL AND "vendor_payment_vouchers"."ledger_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "vendor_payment_vouchers"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL AND "vendor_payment_vouchers"."payment_reference" IS NOT NULL)
